ModMetaData.name: 鼠族世界任務包 / Ratkin Questlines
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
「有鼠族的世界」沉浸式任務包 — 用 Custom Quest Framework（CQF）製作的一系列鼠族相遇任務，讓玩家以聚居點管理者的身分，遇見鼠族社會不同角落的來客：商販、難民、騎士、掮客、學徒……
An immersion-focused questline pack for a world with ratkin in it. Built on Custom Quest Framework (CQF): a growing set of ratkin encounters where the player, as the manager of a settlement, meets travellers from every corner of ratkin society.
首發垂直切片：《陳皮餅乾的老交情》— 一名路過的鼠族旅人上門，兜售旅途乾糧（硬餅乾與啤酒），你可以照價成交、講價宰一筆，或大方待客換交情。 First vertical slice: "An Old Bond over Hardtack" — a passing ratkin traveller offers road provisions; trade fairly, drive a hard bargain, or be generous and earn their goodwill.
依賴 / Requires: Harmony, Custom Quest Framework, NewRatkinPlus. 設計文件見 PROJECT.md。
